about: draws_as_nothing is the first and last code point of each range of crates/core/src/invisible.rs draws_as_nothing, the characters the terminal's question writes out as drawing nothing. A test of that file holds the function to these ranges for every code point, and extension/tests/unseen.test.mjs holds both copies of extension/shown.js to them: the confirmation window marks each of these by its code point, and may mark more. left_unmarked is what neither the function nor spelled_code of that file writes out and the window leaves as drawn, which both tests hold too: U+FFFC, the object replacement character, draws as a visible box, so a person sees that something is there. One range to a line, because the Rust test reads the lists line by line.
